recall.minute: Extensions keep the sequential core but change supervision, agents or constraints. Behavioural cloning minimises −(1/N)Σ log πθ(aᴱ|s) (0.223 at p = 0.8, 1.609 at p = 0.2) but suffers distribution shift: small errors lead to unfamiliar states and compounding mistakes; DAgger labels learner-visited states with the expert and retrains on the aggregate (lane keeping: off-road 12.5% → 0%). Inverse RL infers a reward, often wᵀf(s, a), under which the expert is near-optimal (not unique); MaxEnt IRL makes high-reward trajectories exponentially more likely; GAIL matches expert occupancy with a discriminator; preference models learn R from comparisons via σ(R_A − R_B). Multi-agent RL uses Markov games, facing non-stationarity, mⁿ joint actions, credit assignment and partial observability; CTDE (MADDPG, QMIX, MAPPO) trains with joint information and executes locally. Safe RL maximises J_R s.t. J_C ≤ d with Lagrangian methods, constrained policy optimisation, shielding or intervention, reporting violation rates and tails. Applications span robotics, driving, energy, recommendation, finance and LLM agents, where learned rewards are proxies that can be gamed.
